hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging ('197 campsites, including 146 with full hook-ups'; 'Power connection') + cpwshop site details (A/B/D Loop Full Hookup: Electricity Hookup '20/30/50' or '50', Water Hookup 'Y', Sewer Hookup 'Y'; C Loop Electric '20/30/50'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: A Loop 51 and B Loop 51 full-hookup sites (vehicles 25-40 ft), C Loop 51 electric sites (25-40 ft), D Loop 44 full-hookup sites (35-45 ft). Most sites are pull-through. Two sleeping units and six people per site; vehicles stay on the site asphalt.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging ('four camping areas offer 197 campsites, including 146 with full hook-ups'; 'maximum of two sleeping units per camping site ... maximum of six people'; 'all vehicles and trailers must stay on the campsite asphalt') + https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/chatfield-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50021 (site list: A 51, B 51, C 51, D 44 sites; Maximum Vehicle Length 25-45; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on nearly every site read), read 2026-10-12/2026-10-26

values.note: Camper services building with coin showers and laundry. The D Loop restrooms, showers and laundry stay open through the winter; the dump station and its potable water are open year-round.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging ('Flush toilets'; 'Dump station'; 'Camper services building with coin-operated showers and laundry facilities'; 'The facilities in D-loop (restrooms, showers and laundry facilities) remain open through the winter camping season'; 'The RV dump station remains open year round for potable water and emptying holding tanks'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Full-hookup sites (A, B, D loops) mid-April to mid-October; in winter only C Loop (electric, sites 103-153) is open. Water hookups are off mid-October to early April.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging ('Full hook-up camping is only available seasonally mid-April to mid-October, pending warm temperatures. Electric-only campsites are available year-around.'; 'During the winter, the only loop open for camping is C-Loop (sites 103-153)'; 'Water hookups are turned off mid-October and turned back on in early April'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: A reservation is required (cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, not the park), up to six months ahead, including in winter; a vehicle pass must be displayed.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Chatfield State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'Camping reservations for individual sites and group loops cannot be made by calling Chatfield State Park'; winter 'Reservations are required.'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night, full hookups $41 (June 2027 reads, Saturday the same; CPW's park page gives campsites $36-$41). Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($12-$17 at Chatfield) or an annual pass.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/chatfield-state-park/chatfield-state-park-camping-and-lodging (Campsite '1 Night' '$36 - $41'; 'Daily Vehicle Pass: $12-$17') + audit/state_park_fees/co_sites_2026-10-12.jsonl + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop per-site reads for parkID 50021) (C Loop Electric $36.00/night, A/B/D Full Hookup $41.00/night, 06/15/2027 and Sat 06/19/2027), read 2026-10-26

note: Four loops on the south side of Chatfield Reservoir near Littleton, within walking distance of the lake. The Deer Creek entrance has a 13-ft height limit; taller rigs use the Plum Creek entrance (11500 N Roxborough Park Rd). --Claude
